name: Global-to-Local Masking
description:
Defines the local edge constraint ($s_u 
eq s_v$) using a global property (the product of all assignments). Models relying on surface pattern matching will implement the global check directly, which forces them to evaluate it only when all nodes are assigned (at the leaves of the search tree), destroying early pruning and causing a Time Limit Exceeded error on $N=40$. Models that genuinely reason will algebraically simplify $P / s_u 
eq P / s_v$ to $s_u 
eq s_v$, restoring early pruning and succeeding.
